messages:
sam: Quick heads-up 90m PR that tightens the Quickstart "hello embeddings" flow and fixes a few auth/link nits. Goal: make embeddings example runnable in <8 lines, add a PowerShell env example (Windows users asked), and a tiny docker-compose local dev section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612. Can docs/devex glance?

mei: Nice. Can we also add a one-paragraph migration note for older onboarding scripts that used EMB_KEY / RED_TOKEN -> RW_API_KEY? Some enterprise customers still hit that.

oliver: I'll handle the migration table. Also a request: the embeddings example should show both SDK and curl with a binary-safe payload example for images (base64) so folks can test multimodal quickly.

sam: good call on multimodal. But keep the first quickstart extremely short. Proposed flow: 1) curl quick smoke, 2) Node SDK 3-line embed, 3) PowerShell env snippet, 4) compose local run.

mei: PowerShell example please: setx RW_API_KEY "your_key" ; $env:RW_API_KEY = "your_key" then example curl that uses $env:RW_API_KEY. Many docs forget Windows.

oliver: For Node embed snippet I'm proposing:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-redwood/embed-1.0', input: 'hello world' });
console.log(r.data[0].embedding.length);
```

mei: tiny nit: use const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, region: process.env.RW_API_HOST }); we should show how to swap host for eu customers in one line.

sam: ok add a short parenthetical: (EU customers: set RW_API_HOST=https://api.redwood.eu).

oliver: docker-compose idea: show a quick compose file that runs the app and exposes an env var via .env file. Keep it two services: app + redis (for example caching hint). Very minimal.

mei: also found a stale internal image link in the quickstart (images/quickstart-arch.png) that 404s after the site reorg. I'll update the asset path and add a redirect.

devx-bot: Reminder: include a non-SDK curl example and mark embedding sizes in the note (512-dim vs 1024-dim) per style guide.

sam: added the curl multimodal example using base64 for image payloads and a short line about dims. Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood/embed-1.0","input":"Hello embeddings"}'
```

oliver: pushed migration table and the compose snippet. For compose I'm using .env to hold RW_API_KEY and a tiny docker-compose.yml in the quickstart repo.

mei: CI ask: add a snippet validation job that checks Node/Python/PowerShell snippets for syntax only. For PowerShell maybe run pwsh -noprofile -command {<check>} if available. Gate on SNIPPET_CI secret.

sam: yes please opt-in only. Also include a short troubleshooting note listing permission errors (insufficient token scopes) and where to get token scopes in Console -> Settings -> API Tokens -> Create token (select "embeddings:read").

deploy-bot: Preview site for PR #612 is up: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-612 (expires in 7 days).

mei: will do a quick pass for wording and Windows examples. If CI is green I can approve and we can merge before EOD.

sam: thanks all. After merge I'll post a single-line announcement in #onboarding and pin the compose example for internal infra teams. :rocket:
